title: clitoria rubiginosa var. genuina
intro: Clitoria rubiginosa var. genuina, commonly known as Butterfly Pea, is a plant species in the Fabaceae family, characterized by its vibrant blue flowers and medicinal properties. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, such as inflammation, fever, and digestive issues, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Clitoria rubiginosa var. genuina include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents like flavonoids, glycosides, and alkaloids. The bioactive constituents of this plant, including apigenin, kaempferol, and quercetin, contribute to its therapeutic properties, making it a valuable resource in folk medicine.
